skill.name: ai-music
skill.description: Route AI music generation and audio editing requests to RunComfy models through the runcomfy CLI. It helps choose ElevenLabs Music or ACE Step endpoints and prepares the matching command.
skill.summary: Route AI music generation and audio edits to the right RunComfy model.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Static command findings are mostly Markdown backtick and code-fence false positives, and the system-reconnaissance hits are model-selection prose. The real risks are the expected third-party RunComfy API transfer and persistent API-token storage under the user config directory. No prompt-injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Ask users before sending sensitive prompts, lyrics, or source audio URLs to RunComfy, and link to service data-handling terms.
Keep token files at mode 0600, document token removal, and prefer RUNCOMFY_TOKEN for temporary CI or container sessions.
Require verified package-manager installation and avoid agent-run install commands unless the user explicitly confirms the package source.

content.value_statement: Music creators need a fast way to choose between price, language support, vocals, and editing workflows. This skill routes requests to RunComfy music models and prepares the right CLI call.
actual_capabilities: Routes music requests to ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, or ACE Step 1.5.
Builds RunComfy CLI calls for text-to-music generation.
Supports prompt, tag, lyric, duration, and output-directory choices.
Guides ACE Step audio-inpaint for time-bounded section repairs.
Guides ACE Step audio-outpaint for extending existing tracks.
Explains cost, quality, language, and setup tradeoffs.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Sends prompts, lyrics, tags, and audio URLs to RunComfy services.
Does not verify copyright ownership for user-provided lyrics or audio.
Audio editing is limited to supported ACE Step inpaint and outpaint workflows.

use_cases.title: Create campaign jingles
use_cases.description: Choose a premium route for short vocal hooks, brand themes, and polished ad music.

use_cases.title: Produce game loop drafts
use_cases.description: Use lower-cost ACE Step routes to generate repeatable instrumental beds at scale.

use_cases.title: Repair or extend tracks
use_cases.description: Regenerate a timed section or add an intro and outro around an existing clip.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner instrumental draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30 second instrumental background track for a product demo. Keep it calm, modern, and loop friendly.

prompt_templates.title: Vocal song route
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a model for a complete song.
prompt_templates.prompt: Make a 60 second pop song with English lyrics. Recommend the best RunComfy route before generating.

prompt_templates.title: Extend an existing hook
prompt_templates.scenario: Use audio-outpaint on a source clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have a 30 second hook at this audio URL: [URL]. Extend it into a two minute track with a soft ending.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced batch planning
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare model choices before running a batch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a low-cost batch of 20 multilingual music drafts. Compare ACE Step base, ACE Step 1.5, and ElevenLabs before choosing.

output_examples.input: Need a short polished vocal jingle for a brand launch.
output_examples.output: Recommended ElevenLabs Music for premium vocal quality, with a short prompt, target length, and output directory.

output_examples.input: Need 50 instrumental game loops for early playtests.
output_examples.output: Recommended ACE Step base to reduce cost, with tag variations and 60 second loop guidance.

output_examples.input: Need to replace 20 seconds of a chorus without remaking the whole song.
output_examples.output: Recommended ACE Step audio-inpaint with a start time, end time, matching tags, and instrumental lyrics marker.

best_practices: Confirm budget, duration, vocal needs, and language before selecting a route.
Use short drafts first, then generate longer final tracks after approval.
Confirm rights for any lyrics or source audio before submission.
anti_patterns: Do not send private lyrics, unreleased audio, or confidential campaign text without approval.
Do not use ElevenLabs for high-volume drafts when ACE Step is enough.
Do not use inpaint or outpaint without clear source-audio timing.

faq.question: Does this skill generate music directly?
faq.answer: It uses the RunComfy CLI to submit generation requests and download output files.

faq.question: Which models does it route to?
faq.answer: It covers ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, ACE Step 1.5, ACE Step audio-inpaint, and ACE Step audio-outpaint.

faq.question: Do I need a RunComfy account?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the CLI and either an interactive login or a RUNCOMFY_TOKEN value.

faq.question: Does it send my prompts externally?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts, lyrics, tags, and audio URLs are sent to RunComfy model services.

faq.question: Can it edit existing audio?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide ACE Step inpaint for timed repairs and outpaint for extensions.

faq.question: Does it check music rights?
faq.answer: No. Users must confirm they have rights to supplied lyrics and source audio.
